title: Opportunity
description: Strict data contract for an ASEAN Digital Economy & Workforce Grant/RFP opportunity record stored in data/grants.json and data/grants.csv.

id.description: 10-character lowercase MD5 hash prefix of the canonical opportunity URL.

title.description: Human-readable title of the grant, CFP, tender, or RFP.

source.description: Donor, portal, or publisher name (e.g., DFAT AusConnect, ASEAN Foundation).

open_date.description: Publication or opening date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

close_date.description: Submission deadline in YYYY-MM-DD format, or 'TBD' when unspecified.

deadline_status.description: Computed deadline countdown status recalculated on every pipeline run.

url.description: Canonical URL for the opportunity announcement or portal page.
